rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for news, stories, or events that cause great sadness.

example.english: This news report is truly heartbreaking.
example.traditional: 呢段新聞真係令人心痛。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 san1 man4 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 sam1 tung3

rows.note: Use this for especially intense emotional devastation, stronger than ordinary sadness.

example.english: The news of their breakup was truly heartbreaking.
example.traditional: 佢哋分手嘅消息真係令人心碎。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 fan1 sau2 ge3 siu1 sik1 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 sam1 seoi3
